scenes.title: Hook
scenes.step_card: The timber look. Without the weight.
scenes.narration: Want the look of old timber beams, without the weight?

scenes.title: Real up close
scenes.narration: Meet Heritage Timber, by Ekena Millwork. Each beam is cast from real, weathered timber, so it looks solid, even up close.

actions.label: Cast from real timber + Up close / Across the room

scenes.title: The weight
scenes.narration: A twelve-foot beam weighs about eighteen pounds. One person can lift it.

scenes.title: One-person install
scenes.narration: It slides over a wood block, with standard household tools. And it's hollow, so it can hide wiring.

scenes.title: Why not solid wood?
scenes.narration: And unlike solid wood, it resists warping and cracking, with less upkeep.

scenes.title: Finish and size
scenes.narration: Pick from six hand-stained finishes, or primed. Eight sizes, from four to twenty-four feet long.

actions.label: Finishes change in the room on the beat

scenes.title: Quick Ship
scenes.narration: It's in stock, and ships in three to five business days.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.narration: Order a sample, and see it in your own light.

changes.summary: Brody: 'some of the imagery seems weak and it still feels like things are missing.' Rebuilt objection-led (Ekena creative standards Job Test): each scene now answers one buyer objection instead of listing the catalogue. Hook unchanged, with a slot for a generated bare-ceiling 'before' that wipes to Ekena's real render on the beat (not supplied yet, so the slot shows the real render).
New: 'Cast from real timber': a real macro beside the same finish across a room, labelled Up close / Across the room (H2, H20).

New: the weight objection. 18 lb for a 5 1/2 x 5 1/2 in x 12 ft beam, from the product record (H21); 'One person can lift it' (H22). Slot for a generated one-person photo; until then the real beam cutout.
New: 'Why not solid wood?' table, rows on the beats, every Heritage cell from Ekena's own copy or data (H21-H24).

Textures, finishes and sizes scenes folded into one: the same Ekena room changes finish on each beat, plus a spec table (finishes, textures, sizes, lengths). The full named lists live in the explorer video.
